paragraphs: Yitzchak Kaftora. Mentioned in the Zohar, Tetzaveh 186a.[^1]

notes.text: The supplied locator is קפו.., with a doubled period, rendered 186a under the period convention rather than reproducing both stops in English. Earlier machine OCR had קפז (187). No particular Zohar edition is named or independently verified. Kaftora is a conventional vocalization.
